data.one_liner: Check and listen to the device airplane mode status on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to check whether airplane mode is currently enabled on the device using AirplaneModeChecker.instance.checkAirplaneMode() or listen for real-time state changes using a stream.
use_when: You need to detect if network connectivity is disabled due to airplane mode.
Your app needs to react dynamically when the user toggles airplane mode.
avoid_when: You are targeting WiFi-only iOS devices where airplane mode cannot be reliably detected via public APIs.
You only need general internet connectivity checking without specifically targeting airplane mode.
strengths: Supports both checking status once and streaming changes.
Provides optional fallback values for iOS devices with limited API support.
weaknesses: Limited accuracy and support on WiFi-only iOS devices due to Apple platform constraints.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 12.0 or higher and Android API 16 or higher.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need broader network connectivity types (wifi, cellular, ethernet) rather than exclusively checking airplane mode.
